'''Walter J. Radermacher''' (born 10 June 1952) is a German statistician.<ref name="auto"/> He was President of the [[Federal Statistical Office of Germany|German Federal Statistical Office]] and Director General of [[Eurostat]] and is Professor (hon.) at [[LMU Munich]].

== Career ==
After completing his studies in [[business administration]] in [[Aachen]] and [[Münster]], Radermacher joined the German Federal Statistical Office in 1978.<ref name="auto"/> Radermacher gained his first experience in trade statistics and, in particular, in the planning and implementation of the 1985 trade census, the first large-scale census in Germany after the 1983 census judgement.<ref>{{Cite web | title=Archived copy | url=https://www.itm.nrw/wp-content/uploads/978-3-662-64448-5.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220926071727/https://www.itm.nrw/wp-content/uploads/978-3-662-64448-5.pdf | archive-date=2022-09-26}}</ref> He was then involved in the implementation of modern geo-information systems in official statistics. In the 1990s, he built up the [[Environmental-economic accounting|Environmental Economic Accounts]] at the Federal Statistical Office.<ref>{{cite web |title=Walter Radermacher |url=https://www.bewacherregister.de/EN/About-Us/History/president-radermacher.html |website=Federal Statistical Office |language=en}}</ref>

From 2001 to mid-2003 was Head of Administration at the Federal Statistical Office. Radermacher was appointed Vice President of the Federal Statistical Office at the end of 2003 and President in December 2006.<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://www.destatis.de/EN/About-Us/History/president-radermacher.html|title=Walter Radermacher|website=Federal Statistical Office}}</ref>

As president of the Federal Statistical Office, Radermacher also took over the chairmanship of the [[Council of the European Union]] Working Group on Statistics for the period of the German EU Council Presidency (1st half of 2007). During his inauguration (18 January 2007), Federal Minister of the Interior [[Wolfgang Schäuble]] also appointed Radermacher as [[Federal Returning Officer]] with effect from 19 January 2007.<ref>{{cite web |title=Walter Radermacher neuer Bundeswahlleiter |url=https://www.wahlrecht.de/news/2007/02.htm |website=Wahlrecht.de}}</ref>

Radermacher was appointed Director General of [[Eurostat]] on 1 August 2008.<ref>{{cite web |last1=GAUCKLER |first1=Britta |title=Walter Radermacher |url=https://cros-legacy.ec.europa.eu/content/walter-radermacher_en |website=CROS - European Commission |language=en |date=20 February 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Emmott |first1=Robin |title=Transformed by Greece, Eurostat bares its teeth |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-eu-eurostat-idUKBRE89F0A620121016/ |website=Reuters |date=16 October 2012}}</ref> He remained in office until the end of 2016 and was succeeded by [[Mariana Kotzeva]] in 2018.<ref>{{cite web |title=Bulgarian Mariana Kotzeva becomes head of Eurostat |url=https://bnr.bg/en/post/100787334/bulgarian-mariana-kotzeva-becomes-head-of-eurostat |publisher=Bulgarian National Radio |language=en}}</ref>

From 2017 to 2022, he was a researcher at the Institute of Statistical Sciences at the [[Sapienza University of Rome]], where he obtained his PhD in 2019. He was President of the [[:de:Federation of European National Statistical Societies|Federation of European National Statistical Societies]] (FENStatS) from 2017 to 2023 and has been its vice president since September 2023.<ref>{{cite web |title=The members of the Executive Committee (General Officers) |url=https://www.fenstats.eu/exec |website=Fenstats}}</ref>

From 2022 to 2025, he has been Head of the advisory board on Ethics of the [[International Statistical Institute]] (ISI)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.isi-web.org/advisory-board-ethics|title=Advisory Board on Ethics &#124; ISI|website=International Statistical Institute}}</ref> and has been its Deputy Chair since January 2026. Since 2022, he has been Professor (hon.) at the Statistics Institute of LMU Munich.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.en.statistik.uni-muenchen.de/personen/professoren1/index.html|title=Professors - Department of Statistics |website=LMU Munich}}</ref>

Radermacher is an Honorary Fellow of the [[Royal Statistical Society]] 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Honorary Fellowship |url=https://rss.org.uk/training-events/events/honours/honorary-fellowship/|website=RSS}}</ref>

== Research ==
Radermacher is the author of numerous publications<ref>https://orcid.org/my-orcid?orcid=0000-0001-6586-4529</ref> in the field of statistics and the book ''Official Statistics 4.0 - Verified Facts for People in the 21st Century''.<ref>{{cite journal |title=Official Statistics 4.0: Verified Facts for People in the 21st Century Walter J. Radermacher Springer International Publishing, 2020, xii + 158 pages, $79.99, hardcover {{text|ISBN:}} 978-3-030-31491-0 |journal=International Statistical Review |date=December 2021 |volume=89 |issue=3 |pages=660–661 |doi=10.1111/insr.12476 |url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/insr.12476 |language=en |issn=0306-7734|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
